messages:
Priya: Heads-up for Monday deploy: need a super-compact RN for internal announce + a 1-paragraph for Ops/Sales. Can someone stitch?
Tom: I can draft the one-paragraph for Ops/Sales. Does it need model pins & rollback details or just impact summary?
Priya: Ops/Sales paragraph = high level + who to page. Internal RN in #eng-releases should include pins, rollout plan, rollback criteria, and a link to the smoke checklist.
Ravi: I'll handle pins and rollout steps. Plan: pin infra/service:3.4.1, model: rwd/llama-quant-3.0. Rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 75% -> 100% w/ 10m obs.
Nora: I'll write the rollback criteria. Propose auto-halt on error_rate_1m > 1.5% sustained for 5m OR latency_p95 > 2x baseline for 10m. Manual rollback if eval regressions found.
deploybot: Deploy scheduled: canary-id=cb-20260323-x. Auto-halt rules applied per request.
Tom: Draft for Ops/Sales: "Deploy Monday 2026-03-23 16:00 UTC. No expected customer-visible changes. If you see errors or increased latency, page #oncall (pager duty) and notify Ravi." Want me to post to mailing list?
Priya: Yes post to ops-sales@redwood after RN goes live. I'll post RN in #eng-releases. Attachments: perf graphs and staging run link.
Ravi: added precise pins and rollback targets to the doc: rollback -> infra/service:3.4.0 + model rwd/llama-quant-2.9. Also added canary eval pass thresholds.
Nora: adding a short Support blurb: "No UI changes. If users report timeouts, escalate to #oncall and mention canary-id."
SupportBot: Reminder: please include support contact lines and runbook links in the RN to reduce paging noise.
Priya: Good point. I'll include runbook links: runbooks/deploy-rollback-v2 and runbooks/support-escalation.
Tom: Quick question: who will pin the release note in the channel? I can post, but Priya should pin final version.
Priya: I'll pin after final review. Who can review by T-1hr?
Ravi: I can review.
Nora: I can too.
Tom: I'll post the Ops/Sales email draft now for review.
Tom: (shares) "Heads-up: We will deploy a backend update on Mon 2026-03-23 16:00 UTC. No customer-facing UI changes expected. If you see increased errors or latency, page #oncall and contact Ravi. More details will be in the internal release note."
Priya: looks good. Minor tweak: add support contact number.
Tom: updated.
deploybot: Canary smoke run scheduled Sun 2026-03-22 22:30 UTC. Tag results with cb-20260323-x.
Priya: final checklist for RN post: 1) TL;DR one-liner (Nora) 2) What changed bullets (Ravi) 3) Pins & rollout (Ravi) 4) Rollback criteria (Nora) 5) Support blurb & runbooks (Priya) 6) Links to perf + staging (Tom)
Nora: I added the TL;DR: "Small backend runtime + model quant changes to improve token throughput; no UI change."
Ravi: bullets done. Note: routing-mux config adjusted for canary weighting only.
Priya: everyone ack if you have your items. We'll do a 5m check-in at T-30.
Tom: ack
Ravi: ack
Nora: ack
Priya: thanks. I'll post the RN once Ravi + Nora sign off and ops-bot confirms the change window. :rocket:
